title: Neighborhood Watch Log Status Mix
dataSources: Nextdoor posts (`nextdoor:post`), Ring Neighbors alerts (`ring:neighbor`), neighborhood watch logs (`neighborhood:watch`), and local alerts (`local:alert`).
app: Nextdoor post exports, Ring Neighbors alerts, neighborhood watch logs, and local emergency alert feeds ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=neighborhood:watch
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(patrol_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the neighborhood watch log feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `patrol_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It nudges the overall mood of your neighborhood watch log feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
